"use client"

import type React from "react"
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion"
import Link from "next/link"
import { Calendar, MapPin, Users, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, ExternalLink, Radar, Shield, Eye, Zap } from "lucide-react"
import { ufoTimelineData, getEventData } from "@/data/ufo-timeline-events"

interface FrameRef {
  element: HTMLDivElement | null
  zValue: number
}

const PERSPECTIVE = 800
const Z_SPACING = -2000
const SCROLL_MULTIPLIER = -2 // Negative to move frames towards camera on scroll down

const getClassificationColor = (classification: string) => {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    CE1: "from-cyan-500 to-blue-600",
    CE2: "from-blue-500 to-indigo-600",
    CE3: "from-purple-500 to-pink-600",
    CE4: "from-pink-500 to-red-600",
    Radar: "from-green-500 to-teal-600",
    Military: "from-orange-500 to-amber-600",
    Mass: "from-yellow-500 to-orange-600",
  }
  return colors[classification] || "from-gray-500 to-gray-600"
}

const getClassificationIcon = (classification: string) => {
  const icons: Record<string, React.ReactNode> = {
    CE1: <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />,
    CE2: <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />,
    CE3: <Users className="w-4 h-4" />,
    CE4: <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />,
    Radar: <Radar className="w-4 h-4" />,
    Military: <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />,
    Mass: <Users className="w-4 h-4" />,
  }
  return icons[classification] || <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
}

export default function ZAxisTimeline() {
  const [scrollY, setScrollY] = useState(0)
  const [currentSection, setCurrentSection] = useState(0)

  const lastPosRef = useRef(0)
  const zValues = useRef<number[]>([])
  const framesRef = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([])

  const numSections = ufoTimelineData.length

  useEffect(() => {
    zValues.current = Array.from({ length: numSections }, (_, i) => (numSections - 1 - i) * Z_SPACING)
    framesRef.current = framesRef.current.slice(0, numSections)

    console.log("[v0] Initialized zValues:", zValues.current)
  }, [numSections])

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      const top = document.documentElement.scrollTop || document.body.scrollTop
      const delta = lastPosRef.current - top
      lastPosRef.current = top
      setScrollY(top)

      let closestSection = 0
      let closestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY

      for (let i = 0; i < framesRef.current.length; i++) {
        const frame = framesRef.current[i]
        if (!frame) continue

        zValues.current[i] += delta * SCROLL_MULTIPLIER

        const newZVal = zValues.current[i]

        let opacity = 1
        let display = "flex"

        if (newZVal > PERSPECTIVE) {
          display = "none"
          opacity = 0
        } else if (newZVal > 0) {
          opacity = 1 - newZVal / PERSPECTIVE
        } else if (newZVal < -PERSPECTIVE * 4) {
          opacity = Math.max(0, 1 + (newZVal + PERSPECTIVE * 4) / PERSPECTIVE)
        }

        const distance = Math.abs(newZVal)
        if (distance < closestDistance && newZVal <= 100 && newZVal > -PERSPECTIVE * 3) {
          closestDistance = distance
          closestSection = i
        }

        frame.style.transform = `translateZ(${newZVal}px)`
        frame.style.opacity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, opacity)).toString()
        frame.style.display = display
        frame.style.zIndex = (1000 - i).toString()
      }

      setCurrentSection(closestSection)
    }

    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, { passive: true })

    handleScroll()

    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll)
  }, [numSections])

  const scrollToSection = (index: number) => {
    const targetZ = 0
    const currentZ = zValues.current[index] || 0
    const scrollDelta = (currentZ - targetZ) / SCROLL_MULTIPLIER

    window.scrollBy({
      top: scrollDelta,
      behavior: "smooth",
    })
  }

  const navigateSection = (direction: "prev" | "next") => {
    const newIndex =
      direction === "prev" ? Math.max(0, currentSection - 1) : Math.min(numSections - 1, currentSection + 1)
    scrollToSection(newIndex)
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="relative" style={{ height: `${numSections * 100 + 100}vh` }}>
        <div className="fixed inset-0 overflow-hidden">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-background">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 stars-bg opacity-50" />
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-background/50 to-background" />
          </div>

          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"
            style={{
              perspective: `${PERSPECTIVE}px`,
              perspectiveOrigin: "50% 50%",
              transformStyle: "preserve-3d",
            }}
          >
            {ufoTimelineData.map((section, index) => {
              const eventData = getEventData(section.events[0]?.id || "")

              return (
                <div
                  key={section.year}
                  ref={(el) => {
                    framesRef.current[index] = el
                  }}
                  className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"
                  style={{
                    transformStyle: "preserve-3d",
                    backfaceVisibility: "hidden",
                    transform: `translateZ(${zValues.current[index] ?? (numSections - 1 - index) * Z_SPACING}px)`,
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden">
                    {section.backgroundImage && (
                      <>
                        <img
                          src={section.backgroundImage || "/placeholder.svg"}
                          alt={section.description}
                          className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover"
                        />
                        <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ backgroundColor: section.backgroundOverlay }} />
                      </>
                    )}
                    {!section.backgroundImage && (
                      <div
                        className="absolute inset-0"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: section.backgroundColor || "var(--background)" }}
                      />
                    )}
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,transparent_0%,rgba(0,0,0,0.7)_100%)]" />
                  </div>

                  <div className="relative z-10 max-w-lg mx-4">
                    <div className="flex justify-center mb-4">
                      <div className="relative">
                        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-primary/30 blur-xl rounded-full" />
                        <div className="relative px-6 py-2 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-primary/50 rounded-full">
                          <span className="text-4xl font-bold text-primary font-mono">{section.year}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {eventData && (
                      <div className="bg-card/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-border/50 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
                        <div
                          className={`px-6 py-3 bg-gradient-to-r ${getClassificationColor(eventData.classification)} flex items-center gap-2`}
                        >
                          {getClassificationIcon(eventData.classification)}
                          <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">{eventData.classification}</span>
                        </div>

                        <div className="p-6">
                          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mb-2">{eventData.title}</h2>

                          <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-4 leading-relaxed">{eventData.description}</p>

                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                              {section.events[0]?.date}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                              {eventData.location.split(",")[0]}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                              {eventData.witnesses.toLocaleString()} witnesses
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          <Link
                            href={`/content-card-detail-view?id=${section.events[0]?.id}`}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-primary/20 hover:bg-primary/30 
                              text-primary rounded-lg transition-colors text-sm font-medium"
                          >
                            Explore Case
                            <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Link>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="fixed left-6 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex flex-col gap-2 z-50">
            {ufoTimelineData.map((section, index) => (
              <button
                key={section.year}
                onClick={() => scrollToSection(index)}
                className={`group relative flex items-center gap-3 transition-all duration-300 ${
                  index === currentSection ? "scale-110" : "opacity-50 hover:opacity-100"
                }`}
              >
                <div
                  className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full transition-all ${
                    index === currentSection
                      ? "bg-primary shadow-lg shadow-primary/50"
                      : "bg-muted-foreground/50 group-hover:bg-muted-foreground"
                  }`}
                />
                <AnimatePresence>
                  {index === currentSection && (
                    <motion.span
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                      exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }}
                      className="text-sm font-mono text-primary whitespace-nowrap"
                    >
                      {section.year}
                    </motion.span>
                  )}
                </AnimatePresence>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="fixed right-6 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex flex-col gap-4 z-50">
            <button
              onClick={() => navigateSection("prev")}
              disabled={currentSection === 0}
              className="p-3 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-border rounded-full
                hover:bg-card transition-all disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <ChevronUp className="w-5 h-5 text-foreground" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => navigateSection("next")}
              disabled={currentSection === numSections - 1}
              className="p-3 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-border rounded-full
                hover:bg-card transition-all disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <ChevronDown className="w-5 h-5 text-foreground" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <AnimatePresence>
            {currentSection === 0 && (
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                className="fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 z-50"
              >
                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Scroll to explore</span>
                <motion.div animate={{ y: [0, 8, 0] }} transition={{ repeat: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, duration: 1.5 }}>
                  <ChevronDown className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
                </motion.div>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>

          <div className="fixed bottom-8 right-6 z-50">
            <div className="bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-border rounded-xl px-4 py-2">
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary font-mono">{currentSection + 1}</span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground mx-1">/</span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground font-mono">{numSections}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <style jsx global>{`
        .stars-bg {
          background-image: 
            radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px, white, transparent),
            radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px, rgba(255,255,255,0.8), transparent),
            radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px, white, transparent),
            radial-gradient(2px 2px at 160px 120px, rgba(255,255,255,0.9), transparent),
            radial-gradient(1px 1px at 230px 80px, white, transparent),
            radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 150px, rgba(255,255,255,0.7), transparent),
            radial-gradient(1px 1px at 370px 200px, white, transparent),
            radial-gradient(2px 2px at 450px 50px, rgba(255,255,255,0.8), transparent);
          background-size: 500px 300px;
          animation: twinkle 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes twinkle {
          0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; }
          50% { opacity: 0.8; }
        }
      `}</style>
    </>
  )
}

        "contents": "## 🎯 Feature 1: Timeline Scrubber\n\n### Purpose\nProvide chronological navigation through UFO history with intuitive controls for exploring temporal patterns and key historical events.\n\n### Visual Reference\nBased on screenshot showing:\n- Year display: \"2004\" with era label \"Modern UFO Era\"\n- Timeline slider: 1600-2024 range\n- Playback controls: back, play, forward, speed selector\n- Historical Eras panel with event counts\n- Key Dates display\n- Quick Jump buttons (1947, 2004, 2017)\n\n### Data Architecture\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Core Types\ninterface TimelineEra {\n  id: string\n  name: string\n  range: [number, number] // [start year, end year]\n  eventCount: number\n  description: string\n  color: string // theme color for UI consistency\n  icon?: string\n}\n\ninterface TimelineEvent {\n  id: string\n  title: string\n  date: Date\n  year: number\n  category: string[]\n  isKeyEvent: boolean\n  eventType: 'event' | 'sighting'\n  significance?: number // 0-100 scale\n}\n\ninterface TimelineState {\n  currentYear: number\n  currentDate: Date\n  isPlaying: boolean\n  playbackSpeed: number // 1, 2, 5, 10, 20\n  selectedEra: TimelineEra | null\n  keyEventsFilter: boolean\n  animationFrame: number | null\n}\n\ninterface TimelinePlaybackConfig {\n  minYear: number // 1600\n  maxYear: number // 2024\n  defaultSpeed: number // 1\n  stepSizeYears: number // 1\n  updateIntervalMs: number // 100\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Era Classification System\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nconst ERA_DEFINITIONS: TimelineEra[] = [\n  {\n    id: 'ancient',\n    name: 'Ancient',\n    range: [0, 1800],",

        "contents": "export function HudUapInterface({\n  initialSightings,\n  events = [],\n  analysisResults,\n  initialLocations,\n}: HudUapInterfaceProps) {\n\n\n  // Animation timeline integration\n  const {\n    currentAnimationDate,\n    animationProgress,\n    visibleData: animatedVisibleData,\n    handleTimeSliceChange,\n    handleAnimationProgress,\n    AnimationTimelineManager,\n  } = useAnimationTimeline(enhancedTimeRange, initialSightings, events)\n\n  // Use animated data when animation is active, otherwise use filtered data\n  const currentSightings = enhancedTimeRange.isAnimating\n    ? animatedVisibleData.sightings\n    : filteredSightings\n  const currentEvents = enhancedTimeRange.isAnimating ? animatedVisibleData.events : filteredEvents\n\n  // Combine sightings and events for visualization\n  const combinedData = React.useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    // Convert events to a compatible format for visualization\n    const formattedEvents = currentEvents.map((event) =&gt; ({\n      id: event.id,\n      type: 'event',\n      title: event.title || event.name || 'Unknown Event',\n      content: event.description || '',\n      location: {\n        city: event.location || '',\n        state: '',\n        coordinates:\n          event.latitude &amp;&amp; event.longitude\n            ? {lat: event.latitude, lng: event.longitude}\n            : undefined,\n      },\n      timestamp: event.date || new Date(),\n      category: event.category\n        ? Array.isArray(event.category)\n          ? event.category\n          : [event.category]\n        : [],\n      confidence: 'high',\n      sourceUrl: '',\n      mediaUrls: [],\n    }))\n\n    return [...currentSightings, ...formattedEvents]\n  }, [currentSightings, currentEvents])\n\n  // Initialize filters and data\n  useEffect\n\n}",

            "text": "        coordinates:",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "          event.latitude &amp;&amp; event.longitude",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "            ? {lat: event.latitude, lng: event.longitude}",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "            : undefined,",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "      },",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "      timestamp: event.date || new Date(),",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "      category: event.category",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "        ? Array.isArray(event.category)",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "          ? event.category",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "          : [event.category]",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "        : [],",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "      confidence: 'high',",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "      sourceUrl: '',",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "      mediaUrls: [],",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "    }))",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "    return [...currentSightings, ...formattedEvents]",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "  }, [currentSightings, currentEvents])",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },

            "line": 50,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "/**\n * Tour System Type Definitions\n * Compatible with Universal Agent Tools architecture\n */\n\nexport interface TourWaypoint {\n  id: string\n  entityId: string\n  entityType: 'events' | 'personnel' | 'organizations' | 'documents' | 'testimonies'\n  title: string\n  description: string\n  narrative: string\n  position: {\n    x: number\n    y: number\n  }\n  visited: boolean\n  metadata: {\n    date?: Date | string\n    location?: string\n    year: number\n    era: string\n    historicalSignificance: number\n    relatedEntities: {\n      personnel: string[]\n      organizations: string[]\n      topics: string[]\n    }\n    aiInsights: string[]\n    [key: string]: any\n  }\n}\n\nexport interface Tour {\n  id: string\n  name: string\n  description: string\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "/**",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": " * Tour System Type Definitions",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": " * Compatible with Universal Agent Tools architecture",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": " */",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "export interface TourWaypoint {",
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "isSignature": true
          },

        "contents": "- **Audit Trail**: Complete lineage of documentation changes\n\n### 3. Data Collection Architecture\n\n#### Multi-source Data Integration\n- **System Logs**: Application, server, network, security logs\n- **Monitoring Tools**: Infrastructure monitoring platforms, APM tools\n- **User Reports**: Internal tickets, customer feedback, incident reports\n- **External Feeds**: Vendor notifications, regulatory updates, market data\n- **Sensor Data**: IoT devices, environmental monitors, hardware sensors\n\n#### Collection Protocols\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Example event collection schema\nCREATE TABLE detailed_events (\n    event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,\n    occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,\n    reported_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,\n    event_type VARCHAR(100),\n    sub_type VARCHAR(100),\n    source_system VARCHAR(100),\n    reporter_id VARCHAR(100),\n    severity ENUM('critical','high','medium','low','info'),\n    impact_score DECIMAL(3,2),\n    affected_components JSONB,\n    description TEXT,\n    resolution_status VARCHAR(50),\n    root_cause_analysis JSONB,\n    lessons_learned TEXT[]\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. Analysis Framework and Methodologies\n\n#### Temporal Analysis\n- **Event Sequence Mapping**: Chronological reconstruction of cascading effects\n- **Pattern Recognition**: Recurring themes, cycles, and correlations\n- **Duration Impact Analysis**: Long-term vs. short-term consequence evaluation\n- **Seasonal/Trend Analysis**: Time-based variations and predictable patterns\n\n#### Clustering and Segmentation\n- **Impact-based Clustering**: Grouping events by magnitude and scope\n- **Component-centric Analysis**: Focused analysis on specific systems/processes\n- **Stakeholder Impact Analysis**: Effects on different organizational groups\n- **Financial Impact Segmentation**: Cost categorization and ROI calculations\n\n#### Root Cause Analysis Techniques\n1. **5 Whys Analysis**: Deep dive into causal chains\n2. **Fishbone Diagrams**: Visual cause-effect relationships\n3. **Fault Tree Analysis**: Systematic failure pathway mapping\n4. **Barrier Analysis**: Identification of failed or missing controls\n5. **Change Impact Analysis**: Evaluation of change-induced events",

        "contents": "# Database State Analysis - Xata Instance\n\n## Schema Overview\n\n### Core Entity Tables (28 tables total)\n\n#### Primary Research Entities (Vector-Enabled):\n1. **topics** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: name, summary, photo, photos[], title (unique), embedding\n   - Relationships: Connected to testimonies, experts, users\n\n2. **personnel** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: bio, role, photo[], rank, credibility, popularity, name (unique), authority, embedding\n   - Relationships: Subject matter experts, witnesses, authors, key figures\n\n3. **events** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: name, description, location, latitude, longitude, date, photos[], metadata (JSON), title (unique), summary, category, embedding\n   - Relationships: Connected to experts, testimonies, topics\n\n4. **organizations** (500d embeddings)\n   - Columns: name, specialization, description, photo, image, title (unique), embedding\n   - Relationships: Members, testimonies, documents\n\n5. **testimonies** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: claim, event (link), summary, witness (link), documentation[], date, organization (link), source, media[], context, embedding\n   - Relationships: Events, witnesses, topics\n\n6. **documents** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: file[], summary, embedding, title, date, author (link), organization (link), url, metadata (JSON), images[], processed (bool)\n   - Relationships: Authors, organizations, summary files\n\n7. **artifacts** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: name (unique), description, photos[], date, source, origin, images[], embedding\n   - Relationships: Standalone entity\n\n8. **mindmaps** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: json (JSON), embedding, user (link), file\n   - Relationships: User-created content\n\n#### Geographic &amp; Observational Data:\n9. **sightings**\n   - Columns: date, description, media_link, city, state, country, shape, duration_seconds, duration_hours_min, comments, date_posted, latitude, longitude, media[]\n   - Relationships: User saved items\n\n10. **locations**\n    - Columns: name, coordinates, google-maps-location-id, city, state, latitude, longitude",

Categories\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface Topics {\n  name: string;\n  title: string; // unique\n  summary: text;\n  photo: file;\n  photos: file[];\n  embedding: vector[1536];\n  // Rev links: topic-subject-matter-experts, topics-testimonies, etc.\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### **&#96;events&#96;** - UAP Incidents &amp; Sightings\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface Events {\n  name: string;\n  description: text;\n  date: datetime;\n  location: link&lt;Locations&gt;;\n  embedding: vector[1536];\n  credibility_score: int;\n  // Complex relationships with personnel, organizations, testimonies\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### **&#96;personnel&#96;** - Key Figures in UAP Research\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface Personnel {\n  name: string; // unique\n  bio: text;\n  role: string;\n  rank: int;\n  credibility: int;\n  authority: int;\n  popularity: int;\n  photo: file[];\n  embedding: vector[1536];\n  // Rev links: organization-members, subject-matter-experts\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### **&#96;organizations&#96;** - Government Agencies &amp;         "contents": "import { ScrollThrough3D } from '@/features/3d/scroll-through-3d'\n\nimport { getXataClient } from '@db'\n\nconst xata = getXataClient()\n\nexport default async function Index() {\n  const records: any = await xata.db.events\n    .sort( 'date', 'desc' )\n    .select( [\n      'name',\n      'description',\n      'location',\n      'latitude',\n      'longitude',\n      'date',\n      'photos',\n      'photos.signedUrl',\n      'photos.enablePublicUrl',\n      {\n        name: '&lt;-event-subject-matter-experts.event',\n        columns: ['*'],\n        as: 'experts',\n      },\n    ] )\n    .getAll()\n\n  const expertPersonnel = await xata.db['event-subject-matter-experts']\n    .select( [\n      'event.id',\n      'subject-matter-expert.id',\n      'subject-matter-expert.name',\n      'subject-matter-expert.photo',\n    ] )\n    .getAll()\n\n  const personnel = expertPersonnel\n    .toSerializable()\n    .map( ( { event, id, xata: xataMeta, ...rest } ) =&gt; ( {\n      ...rest['subject-matter-expert'],\n      eventId: event?.id,\n    } ) )\n\n  const data = records.toSerializable()\n\n  const events = data.map( ( event: { experts: { records: any[] } } ) =&gt; {\n    if ( event?.experts?.records ) {\n      const experts = event.experts.records.map( ( expert ) =&gt; expert )\n      return {\n        ...event,\n        experts,\n      }\n    }\n    return event\n  } )\n\n  const removeEmptyKeys = ( obj: any ) =&gt; {\n    const newObj: any = {}\n    for ( const key in obj ) {\n      if ( obj[key] &amp;&amp; obj[key].length ) {\n        newObj[key] = obj[key]\n      }\n    }\n    return newObj\n  }\n  function removeLeadingZero( input ) {\n    const str = String( input )\n    return str.startsWith( '0' ) ? str.slice( 1 ) : str\n  }\n\n  const eventsByYear: any = removeEmptyKeys\n\n}",

        "contents": "# Timeline Scrubber &amp; Network Explorer Implementation Plan\n\n**Created**: 2025-11-25  \n**Status**: Planning Phase  \n**Priority**: High (Core Navigation Features)\n\n## Executive Summary\n\nThis document outlines the comprehensive implementation plan for two critical navigation features in the Ultraterrestrial Research Platform:\n\n1. **Timeline Scrubber**: Chronological navigation through centuries of UFO history with playback controls\n2. **Network Explorer**: Predefined network templates for exploring relationship graphs\n\nBoth features build upon existing infrastructure (Enhanced Tour Controller, Contextual Intelligence, Spatial Intelligence) following the \"orchestration over replacement\" principle.\n\n---\n\n## 📊 Current Infrastructure Assessment\n\n### Existing Systems (Leverage These)\n\n#### Database Layer\n- **Events Model** (&#96;packages/db/src/xata-typescript-sdk/models/events.ts&#96;)\n  - 230,998+ records with date, location, category fields\n  - Comprehensive CRUD operations\n  - Date-based queries: &#96;getAllEvents()&#96;, &#96;searchEvents()&#96;, &#96;getEventsByLocation()&#96;\n  - Vector search capabilities for semantic understanding\n  - Geographic filtering with Haversine distance calculations\n\n#### Tour System\n- **Enhanced Tour Controller** (&#96;use-enhanced-tour-controller.ts&#96;)\n  - Spatial intelligence integration\n  - Chronological navigation patterns\n  - Temporal alignment with timeline axis\n  - Layout animation and history management\n  - Performance metrics tracking\n\n#### Graph Infrastructure\n- **XYFlow Integration** (&#96;xata-to-xyflow.ts&#96;)\n  - Database → graph conversion utilities\n  - Node/edge type mappings\n  - Relationship extraction\n\n- **Network Generation** (&#96;get-entity-network-graph-data.ts&#96;)\n  - Multi-depth relationship traversal\n  - Entity-centric graph building\n\n#### UI Patterns\n- **Enhanced Nodes** - Common UI layer across all features\n- **Contextual Intelligence** - Smart badges, filtering, suggestions\n- **Spatial Intelligence** - R-Tree indexing, proximity analysis\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 Feature 1: Timeline Scrubber\n\n### Purpose",

        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "\"use client\"\n\nimport { useRef, useMemo, useState, useCallback } from \"react\"\nimport { Canvas, useFrame, useThree } from \"@react-three/fiber\"\nimport { OrbitControls } from \"@react-three/drei\"\nimport * as THREE from \"three\"\n\nfunction GlobeObject() {\n  const globeRef = useRef&lt;THREE.Group&gt;(null)\n  const dotsRef = useRef&lt;THREE.Points&gt;(null)\n  const atmosphereRef = useRef&lt;THREE.Mesh&gt;(null)\n  const glowRef = useRef&lt;THREE.Mesh&gt;(null)\n  const ringsRef = useRef&lt;THREE.Group&gt;(null)\n\n  // Create the globe geometry\n  const globeGeometry = useMemo(() =&gt; new THREE.SphereGeometry(2, 64, 64), [])\n\n  // Create the atmosphere geometry\n  const atmosphereGeometry = useMemo(() =&gt; new THREE.SphereGeometry(2.1, 64, 64), [])\n\n  // Create the glow geometry\n  const glowGeometry = useMemo(() =&gt; new THREE.SphereGeometry(2.15, 32, 32), [])\n\n  // Create the dots for the globe\n  const { positions, sizes } = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    const positions = []\n    const sizes = []\n\n    // Create random dots on the surface of the sphere\n    for (let i = 0; i &lt; 2500; i++) {\n      const phi = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2\n      const theta = Math.random() * Math.PI\n      const r = 2 + Math.random() * 0.02\n\n      const x = r * Math.sin(theta) * Math.cos(phi)\n      const y = r * Math.sin(theta) * Math.sin(phi)\n      const z = r * Math.cos(theta)\n\n      positions.push(x, y, z)\n      sizes.push(Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.1)\n    }\n\n    return {\n      positions: new Float32Array(positions),\n      sizes: new Float32Array(sizes),\n    }\n  }, [])\n\n  // Create the rings\n  const rings = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    const rings = []\n    const ringCount = 3\n\n    for (let i = 0; i &lt; ringCount; i++) {\n      const radius = 2.3 + i * 0.2\n      const segments = 128\n      const ringGeometry = new THREE.RingGeometry(radius, radius + 0.03, segments)\n      rings.push(ringGeometry)\n    }\n\n    return rings\n  }, [])\n\n  // Custom shader for the globe\n  const globeMaterial = useMemo\n\n}",

        "contents": "'use client'\n\nimport {Canvas, useFrame, useLoader} from '@react-three/fiber'\nimport {useGLTF} from '@react-three/drei'\nimport {motion} from 'framer-motion-3d'\nimport type React from 'react'\nimport {Suspense, memo, useRef, Component, useState, useEffect} from 'react'\nimport type * as THREE from 'three'\nimport {TextureLoader} from 'three'\n\n// Error Boundary for texture loading failures\nclass EarthErrorBoundary extends Component&lt;{children: React.ReactNode}, {hasError: boolean}&gt; {\n  constructor(props: {children: React.ReactNode}) {\n    super(props)\n    this.state = {hasError: false}\n  }\n\n  static getDerivedStateFromError() {\n    return {hasError: true}\n  }\n\n  componentDidCatch(error: Error) {\n    console.error('Earth component error:', error)\n  }\n\n  render() {\n    if (this.state.hasError) {\n      return (\n        &lt;div className='flex items-center justify-center h-full w-full'&gt;\n          &lt;div className='text-white text-center'&gt;\n            &lt;p&gt;Earth visualization temporarily unavailable&lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      )\n    }\n\n    return this.props.children\n  }\n}\n\n// Define prop types (replace 'any' with actual types)\ntype RotatingComponentProps = {}",

        "contents": "// Main component refactored to use react-three/fiber. It sets up the scene, lights, controls, and postprocessing.\nexport function ScrollThrough3D({years}: {years: number[]}) {\n  const colors = ['#000', '#000', '#000', '#000', '#000']\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Canvas\n      style={{width: '100vw', height: '100vh'}}\n      shadows\n      camera={{fov: 75, near: 0.1, far: 1000}}&gt;\n      &lt;ambientLight intensity={0.5} /&gt;\n      &lt;pointLight position={[50, 50, 50]} intensity={1} /&gt;\n      &lt;OrbitControls\n        enableDamping={false}\n        minPolarAngle={Math.PI / 4}\n        maxPolarAngle={Math.PI / 2}\n        enablePan={false}\n        enableZoom={false}\n        minAzimuthAngle={-Math.PI / 4}\n        maxAzimuthAngle={Math.PI / 4}\n        minDistance={1}\n        maxDistance={70}\n      /&gt;\n      &lt;CameraController path={pathCurve} colors={colors} /&gt;\n      &lt;Tube path={pathCurve} /&gt;\n      &lt;Particles /&gt;\n      {/* Section texts */}\n      &lt;TextOnPath text='Section 1' pathPosition={0.01} scale={0.5} size={1} /&gt;\n      &lt;TextOnPath text='Section 2' pathPosition={0.26} scale={0.5} size={1} /&gt;\n      &lt;TextOnPath text='Section 3' pathPosition={0.51} scale={0.5} size={1} /&gt;\n      &lt;TextOnPath text='Section 4' pathPosition={0.76} scale={0.5} size={1} /&gt;\n      &lt;TextOnPath text='Section 5' pathPosition={0.98} scale={0.5} size={1} /&gt;\n      {/* Year texts rendered along the path */}\n      {years.map((year, index) =&gt; (\n        &lt;TextOnPath\n          key={year}\n          text={year.toString()}\n          pathPosition={index / years.length}\n          scale={0.1}\n          size={2}\n          posOffset={[-4, 0, 0]}\n        /&gt;\n      ))}\n      &lt;EffectComposer&gt;\n        &lt;UnrealBloom threshold={0} strength={0.7} radius={0} /&gt;\n      &lt;/EffectComposer&gt;\n    &lt;/Canvas&gt;\n  )\n}",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "function extractGroupTimespan(nodes: Node[]): { startYear?: number, endYear?: number } {\n  const dates = nodes\n    .map(node =&gt; {\n      const date = node.data?.date || node.data?.timestamp || node.data?.eventDate\n      return date ? new Date(date as string) : null\n    })\n    .filter(Boolean)\n    .map(date =&gt; date!.getFullYear())\n  \n  if (dates.length === 0) return {}\n  \n  return {\n    startYear: Math.min(...dates),\n    endYear: Math.max(...dates)\n  }\n}\n\nfunction suggestGroupConnections(group: SpatialGroup, otherGroups: SpatialGroup[]): Array&lt;{\n  targetGroupId: string\n  connectionType: string\n  reason: string\n}&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "import { xata } from '@/db/xata/client';\n\n/**\n * Fetch events within a specified time range, with pagination\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getEventsByTimeChunk(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n  limit: number = 100\n) {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's filter to get events within date range\n    const eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .sort('date', 'desc')\n      .getPaginated({\n        pagination: {\n          size: limit\n        }\n      });\n\n    return eventsRecords.records;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching events by time chunk:', error);\n    return [];\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for events based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality for efficient computation\n */",

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "---\ndescription: Standardize human-readable date formatting and documentation metadata (authorship vs repo-added) across the project\nglobs: **/*.md, **/*.mdc, **/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}\nalwaysApply: false\n---\n\n- **Human‑Readable Date Format (UI/Docs)**\n  - Use: \"June 12th 2005\" (token pattern: &#96;MMMM do yyyy&#96;)\n  - Ordinal day required (&#96;1st&#96;, &#96;2nd&#96;, &#96;3rd&#96;, &#96;4th&#96;, ...)\n  - Prefer locale &#96;en-US&#96;\n\n- **Machine/Metadata Date Format**\n  - Use ISO 8601 UTC: &#96;YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ&#96; (e.g., &#96;2025-06-12T00:00:00Z&#96;)\n  - Front matter fields for docs: &#96;created&#96;, &#96;lastUpdated&#96;\n  - Do not store ordinals in metadata; ordinals are display-only\n\n- **Semantics: Created vs Added to Repo**\n  - **Created (authorship)**: the document’s authoring date (front matter/header)\n  - **Added to Repo**: earliest Git author date for the file (first commit adding it)\n  - When communicating dates, prefer authorship for content provenance, and explicitly note repo-added when relevant to VCS history\n\n- **Approved Libraries/Patterns**\n  - &#96;date-fns&#96; UI formatting: &#96;format(date, 'MMMM do yyyy')&#96;\n  - &#96;dayjs&#96; (if already present in the module) with &#96;advancedFormat&#96; plugin: &#96;dayjs(date).format('MMMM Do YYYY')&#96;\n  - Avoid raw &#96;Intl.DateTimeFormat&#96; for ordinals (no native ordinal support)\n\n- **Code Examples (update existing patterns)**\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n  // date-fns (Before → After)\n  import { format } from 'date-fns'\n  const before = format(date, 'MMMM d, yyyy')\n  const after  = format(date, 'MMMM do yyyy') // \"June 12th 2005\"\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n  // dayjs with advancedFormat (only where dayjs is already used)\n  import dayjs from 'dayjs'\n  import advancedFormat from 'dayjs/plugin/advancedFormat'\n  dayjs.extend(advancedFormat)\n  const s = dayjs(date).format('MMMM Do YYYY') // \"June 12th 2005\"\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- **Front Matter Template (Markdown)**\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n  ---\n  title: My Document\n  description: Short purpose statement",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "description: Standardize human-readable date formatting and documentation metadata (authorship vs repo-added) across the project",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "globs: **/*.md, **/*.mdc, **/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "alwaysApply: false",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Human‑Readable Date Format (UI/Docs)**",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Use: \"June 12th 2005\" (token pattern: &#96;MMMM do yyyy&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Ordinal day required (&#96;1st&#96;, &#96;2nd&#96;, &#96;3rd&#96;, &#96;4th&#96;, ...)",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Prefer locale &#96;en-US&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Machine/Metadata Date Format**",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Use ISO 8601 UTC: &#96;YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ&#96; (e.g., &#96;2025-06-12T00:00:00Z&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Front matter fields for docs: &#96;created&#96;, &#96;lastUpdated&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Do not store ordinals in metadata; ordinals are display-only",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Semantics: Created vs Added to Repo**",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "  - **Created (authorship)**: the document’s authoring date (front matter/header)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "  - **Added to Repo**: earliest Git author date for the file (first commit adding it)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "  - When communicating dates, prefer authorship for content provenance, and explicitly note repo-added when relevant to VCS history",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Approved Libraries/Patterns**",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;date-fns&#96; UI formatting: &#96;format(date, 'MMMM do yyyy')&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;dayjs&#96; (if already present in the module) with &#96;advancedFormat&#96; plugin: &#96;dayjs(date).format('MMMM Do YYYY')&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Avoid raw &#96;Intl.DateTimeFormat&#96; for ordinals (no native ordinal support)",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Code Examples (update existing patterns)**",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  // date-fns (Before → After)",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "  import { format } from 'date-fns'",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  const before = format(date, 'MMMM d, yyyy')",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "  const after  = format(date, 'MMMM do yyyy') // \"June 12th 2005\"",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  // dayjs with advancedFormat (only where dayjs is already used)",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  import dayjs from 'dayjs'",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  import advancedFormat from 'dayjs/plugin/advancedFormat'",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "  dayjs.extend(advancedFormat)",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "  const s = dayjs(date).format('MMMM Do YYYY') // \"June 12th 2005\"",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Front Matter Template (Markdown)**",

        "contents": "export function getGraphContext( nodes: Node[] ): GraphContext | null {\n\n\n    // Analyze all data nodes to build context\n    dataNodes.forEach( node =&gt; {\n      try {\n        // Extract entity type from node type (e.g., 'eventsNode' -&gt; 'events')\n        const entityType = node.type?.replace( 'Node', '' ).replace( 'enhancedEntityNodePOC', '' ).toLowerCase() || ''\n        if ( entityType &amp;&amp; entityType.length &gt; 0 ) {\n          context.connectedEntityTypes.add( entityType )\n        }\n\n        // Safely extract temporal context from events\n        const nodeDate = extractDateFromNode( node )\n        if ( nodeDate &amp;&amp; !isNaN( nodeDate.getTime() ) ) {\n          if ( !context.timelineBounds.earliest || nodeDate &lt; context.timelineBounds.earliest ) {\n            context.timelineBounds.earliest = nodeDate\n          }\n          if ( !context.timelineBounds.latest || nodeDate &gt; context.timelineBounds.latest ) {\n            context.timelineBounds.latest = nodeDate\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Extract related entities with null safety\n        const topics = extractTopicsFromNode( node )\n        if ( topics.length &gt; 0 ) {\n          context.relatedTopics.push( ...topics )\n        }\n\n        const personnel = extractPersonnelFromNode( node )\n        if ( personnel.length &gt; 0 ) {\n          context.keyPersonnel.push( ...personnel )\n        }\n\n        const organizations = extractOrganizationsFromNode( node )\n        if ( organizations.length &gt; 0 ) {\n          context.organizations.push( ...organizations )\n        }\n\n        // Extract coordinates for location context\n        const coords = extractCoordinatesFromNode( node )\n        if ( coords ) {\n          coordinates.push( coords )\n        }\n      } catch ( error ) {\n        console.warn( &#96;getGraphContext: Error processing node ${node.id}:&#96;, error )\n        // Continue processing other nodes\n      }\n    } )\n\n    // Remove duplicates and clean up arrays\n    context.relatedTopics = [...new Set( context.relatedTopics )].filter( Boolean )\n    context.keyPersonnel = [...new Set( context.keyPersonnel )].filter( Boolean )\n    context.organizations = [...new Set( context.organizations )].\n}",

(\n                &lt;span key={tag} className=\"px-2 py-0.5 text-xs bg-muted text-muted-foreground rounded-full\"&gt;\n                  {tag}\n                &lt;/span&gt;\n              ))}\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/Link&gt;\n    &lt;/motion.div&gt;\n  )\n}",

## Summary

Redesigned the timeline UI using Three.js and React Three Fiber, based on the reference design.

### Created Components

1. **3D Z-Axis Timeline Component** (`apps/app/src/features/timeline/3d-z-axis-timeline.tsx`)
   - Scroll-based 3D navigation along the Z-axis
   - Event cards positioned in 3D space with depth-based opacity
   - Year labels that appear for each unique year
   - Classification colors and icons matching the reference design
   - Smooth camera movement based on scroll position

2. **Features Implemented**
   - 3D event cards with HTML overlays showing event details
   - Scroll-based camera movement along Z-axis
   - Navigation controls (left sidebar with year indicators, right sidebar with prev/next buttons)
   - Progress indicator showing current position
   - Stars background animation
   - Grid helper for depth perception
   - Hover effects and active state highlighting
   - Empty state handling

3. **Integration**
   - Integrated with `TimelineViews` component
   - Replaced the "3D Journey" placeholder view
   - Uses existing `EventsRecord` data structure from Xata
   - Compatible with existing view selector

### Key Features

- 3D perspective: Events arranged along the Z-axis with scroll-based navigation
- Visual design: Classification colors, icons, and styling matching the reference
- Performance: Uses React Three Fiber optimizations and proper memoization
- User experience: Smooth scrolling, navigation controls, and visual feedback
- Data integration: Works with existing Xata events data structure

### Usage

Select "3D Journey" from the view selector on the timeline page to view the new 3D timeline. The component automatically processes events, groups them by year, and creates an interactive 3D experience.

The component is ready to use and follows the project's coding standards and patterns.
